class.name: IfcSymbolStyle
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The symbol style is the presentation style that indicates the presentation of annotation symbols. NOTE: Corresponding ISO 10303 name: symbol_style. Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-46:1994, p. 124 for the final definition of the formal standard. HISTORY: New entity in Release IFC2x2.

members.member: The style applied to the symbol for its visual appearance. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
